notes: The central graduate admission site (admission-global.skku.edu) and almost all department/college sub-sites (engineering, software, economics, interaction science, data science, liberal arts, etc.) answer the snapshot tool's robots.txt request with no response, which the tool treats as a block, so their English-track eligibility, TOEFL/IELTS and TOPIK requirements could not be collected. Only the SKK Graduate School of Business site (gsb.skku.edu) was fetchable; its programmes are collected below. SKK GSB timelines list deadlines without a year (e.g. Full-Time MBA Round 1 'Nov 6' and Round 2 'Feb 26' for the 2027 incoming class; Professional MBA Round 1 'Sep 1-Oct 16', Round 2 'Oct 17-Nov 13'; AI MBA same windows; Executive MBA 'Oct 12', 'Nov 27', 'April 9'), so no deadline is recorded. MMS page states 'Application Deadline June 26, 2026', already past on the collection date, so it is not recorded as a field. SKK GSB Full-Time MBA, MMS and the others accept an English test score from TOEFL, TOEIC, TEPS, IELTS, TOEIC Speaking, OPIc, Duolingo or PTE, but the pages give no minimum score except MMS. The Graduate School of Governance 'Spring 2027 Graduate School of Governance Admissions Guide' notice (https://www.skku.edu/eng/CampusLife/skku/Notice1.do?mode=view&articleNo=140089) gives 'Application Period: November 24, 2026 (Tue), 10:00 - December 2, 2026 (Wed), 17:00' for the second round, but does not state the degree level or the English requirement; the guideline itself is a PDF-only document and was not collected. SKKU also publishes general graduate application guides as PDFs (not readable by the tool). Coordinator: the Executive MBA was removed, as executive programmes are elsewhere.
